name: Presence Tracker
description: Detects presence via MQTT topics and updates a Home Assistant input_boolean. Configurable device list and debounce time via script header.

name: Climate Scheduler
description: Sets heating setpoints based on time-of-day slots and calendar events. Supports multiple thermostats and away mode.

name: Battery Monitor
description: Scans all battery entities in Home Assistant and sends a notification when any device drops below a configurable threshold.

name: Sunrise Lights
description: Gradually brightens selected lights before wake-up time, simulating a sunrise. Wake time is read from a HA input_datetime helper.

name: MQTT Device Bridge
description: Bridges arbitrary MQTT topics to Home Assistant entities. Configurable topic map in the script header — no code changes needed for new devices.
